entity: Florida Game and Fresh Water Fish Commission
stance_basis: letter explicitly states most Department of Interior lands should be closed to off-road vehicle use
summary: The Florida Game and Fresh Water Fish Commission submitted a letter opposing broad ORV use on Department of Interior lands, arguing that most such lands should be closed to off-road vehicles due to damage to watersheds, plant and animal life, and disruption of wildlife feeding and breeding grounds. The Commission also noted that limiting recreational area accessibility improves recreation quality. Their letter was referenced by the Florida Division of State Planning's clearinghouse summary as one of the letters 'endorsing the proposal or offering no adverse comments,' though the letter's actual content is clearly opposed to permissive ORV use.
complaint_summary: The Florida Game and Fresh Water Fish Commission argues that most Department of Interior lands should be closed to ORV use, citing damage to watersheds, plant and animal life, and disruption of wildlife feeding and breeding grounds.

statement.text:
Our agency, whose prime responsibility is the management of game and fish, believes that most Department of Interior lands should be closed to off-road vehicle use. Damage to watersheds, plant and animal life, disruption of feeding and breeding grounds for wildlife are but a few of the problems caused by the use of such vehicles. Limiting the accessibility of recreational areas provides better quality recreation.
We appreciate the opportunity to comment on this project. If we may be of further assistance, please advise.
